summary.name: bumpgen
summary.one_liner: bumpgen is a tool that upgrades a package's dependency version in your codebase and attempts to make the code changes needed when the upgrade breaks things.
use_cases: upgrade a npm package to a newer major version
fix code broken by a library upgrade
automate breaking-change migrations in a TypeScript codebase
let an LLM apply code edits after a dependency update
summary.what_it_does: It uses ts-morph to parse your codebase into an AST so it can understand code relationships. It reads type definitions for external methods from the package to work out how to use the new version. It builds a plan graph (DAG) to execute fixes in dependency order. Usage is a CLI command that takes a package name and a target version, such as @tanstack/react-query at 5.28.14. It requires an OpenAI API key.
notable: Uses ts-morph AST analysis and package type definitions to guide code changes
Plans fixes as a DAG, referencing arxiv paper 2309.12499
Built on OpenAI gpt-4-turbo-preview, the only supported model at this time
caveats: Only supports OpenAI gpt-4-turbo-preview at this time
